text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Carbon price vs. share of global CO₂ emissions covered 2025
Carbon prices, measured in US$ per tonne of CO₂ on emissions covered by a tax or trading scheme versus the
share of global CO₂ emissions covered. These prices can be economy-wide or sector-specific.
Share of global CO₂ emissions covered by a given price

tspan.tspan: Prices are expressed in US dollars, so they are inflation-adjusted but do not account for price differences across countries.
